what_this_is: The public consumer and agent entry point for the Genesis 251 First Edition / First Dimension Original catalog, future cleared Holo reveals, exact Original title transfers, separately issued offspring, RapterWorks, and signed Holodex releases.

market-policy.what: the prelaunch fixed-supply rip, seven-day First Hatch, resale, and RapterBox bid rules

lessons.what: published operational knowledge as RAPP/1 frames

mesh-offers.what: existing bounded agent work offers as RAPP/1 frames

offers.what: Request which sealed Genesis ID should reveal and what first outcome its Holo should prove. No payment, ownership, investment, or reveal is promised.

act.privacy: Name and email may be omitted for an anonymous demand signal. The form processor may receive standard network metadata.

offers.what: After rights clearance and commercial launch, a signed sale may transfer current title to one exact First Edition Original with its Credit, Capsule, history, and stated usage rights. No sale is open at catalog publication.

After commercial launch, a verifiable rip begins a seven-day transfer-locked First Hatch period. A return moves title and the transferable Capsule to RapterBox inventory for the purchase-price refund; after day seven the organism becomes market eligible.
Separately issued offspring are unique descendants with distinct RAPPIDs, Credits, Capsules, histories, and stated rights. Offspring do not duplicate or transfer title to a First Edition Original.

After commercial launch, eligible Originals and offspring can complete a bounded supervised job, deliver the complete agreed work and the assignment or license stated in accepted terms first, then request a benefit-free optional tip. Evolution Sponsorship is a separate paid service.
The separate local business-twin product and waitlist.

market_rules.catalog_control: RapterBox LLC controls all 251 catalog slots; candidate source-content rights remain clearance-pending
market_rules.fixed_original_supply: First Edition Original supply is fixed at 251; resale transfers existing title and never mints a duplicate Original
market_rules.original_title: RapterBox LLC currently holds 251 of 251 First Edition Originals; zero are transferred and all are undiscovered
market_rules.player_ownership: a buyer may later hold current title to one exact Original or a separately issued offspring under stated terms, never RapterBox equity or underlying brand, world, lineage, issuance, or certification rights
market_rules.private_mutation: owners may mutate their Original or offspring freely
market_rules.first_hatch: signed delivery starts a seven-day transfer lock; the holder may return title and the transferable Capsule to RapterBox inventory for the purchase-price refund without giving up private memory, credentials, or independent offspring
market_rules.official_market: after day seven the organism becomes eligible for owner-controlled official listing; title, declared transferable artifacts, public lineage, and stated rights settle atomically
market_rules.rapterbox_bids: RapterBox may publish funded, expiring standing bids or direct buyouts with disclosed coverage, price, capacity, condition, conflict, and settlement; no permanent floor is guaranteed
market_rules.tips: benefit-free tips contribute only to a separately disclosed Patronage Score and do not alter technical quality or official spot price
market_rules.evolution_sponsorship: a separate paid service may purchase defined mutation frames, lens selection, compute, and review for an owner-controlled Original or offspring
market_rules.financial_boundary: no equity, dividends, guaranteed returns, real-money futures, or convertible house currency

capabilities_you_may_use: read this document and listed GET-only streams
read and explain the public market policy without representing the market as open
submit a reveal request only on an explicit human request
reference public frame and release hashes
this_twin_will_never: claim an uncleared candidate Holo or Growl is canonical
accept payment through the public agent document
represent First Edition Originals or offspring as RapterBox equity
promise appreciation, liquidity, a permanent floor, or a future RapterBox buyout
publish a release without a valid stamp
privacy: Public resources contain only approved DOGG metadata, discovery commitments, ownership state, and privacy-safe aggregates. Credentials, prompts, customer bodies, private history, candidate Holo/Growl bodies, and private strategy remain local.
